_source: Population by region, 2022 Population and Housing Census (Sensa ya Watu na Makazi ya Mwaka 2022: Matokeo ya Mwanzo), Jedwali Na. 1. National Bureau of Statistics and the Office of the Chief Government Statistician Zanzibar, Dodoma, October 2022.
_verification: Transcribed three times independently and cross-checked against the 31 per-region infographic pages in the same report: no cell in dispute, no mismatch between the two sources, male+female equals the total on every row, and the 31 regions sum to 61,741,120 -- the published national total.
_note: Area is NOT taken from here -- this is a population and housing census and carries none. It is measured from the 2020 district boundaries in build_basemap.py, which is what gives Songwe an area at all and stops Mbeya's still including it.
